versions.changelog:
- Shortened references to Steve Krug's book title in the description and methodology attribution for conciseness.
- Removed the extended subtitle from the description, focusing on core functionality.
- Trimmed methodology attribution wording, keeping the emphasis on Krug's UX approach while making it more concise.
- No changes to features or audit steps; only editorial improvements for clarity and brevity.

Initial release of the Steve Krug UX Audit skill.

- Perform structured UX audits on any website or web app using Steve Krug's methodology from "Don't Make Me Think, Revisited".
- Review real pages (via URL or local path) for usability, clarity, navigation, and mobile responsiveness.
- Identifies and prioritizes issues based on Krug’s core principles, laws, and heuristics.
- Outputs actionable audits highlighting both critical problems and quick wins.
- Suitable for pre-launch checks, competitor analysis, or design reviews.
